description: Details required by Condition 2 (Detailed drawings or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the work is begun and the works shall not be carried out other than in accordance with the details so approved and shall thereafter be so maintained: (a) kitchen joinery - specification and photo of material, colour and finish and elevations 1:10 and sections 1:5 drawings, and (b) kitchen island  - specification and photo of material, colour and finish and elevations 1:10 and sections 1:5 drawings) of listed building consent LB/25/05019 (Internal alterations at first floor level (Listed Building Consent only))
